name: Venomancer: Tome of Ahn'kahet stays through costless spells and is spent by a spell with a cost (#7767)
contract: #7767: the Tome of Ahn'kahet buff 504341 reads 'Your next spell has its cost reduced by 100%' (MOD_POWER_COST_SCHOOL_PCT -100, all schools). The report says Claw Strike 803198 and Carapace Regeneration 805931, which have no power cost (ManaCost, ManaCostPerlevel, ManaCostPercentage and ManaPerSecond all 0), consume it. Expected: the buff stays through those casts and is removed by the next spell that has a cost, here Carapace Crash 803199 (250 raw Rage), whose cost the buff reduces to 0 while it is active.
